I've built and saved `candidate_01`, a single-storey, 10 m × 20 m building with 8 spaces and 21 openings. It is unreviewed against the drawing: source geometry checks pass, but drawing fidelity is not evaluated.

**Basis.** Only one plan (`1f_view.png`) was supplied, so there is no assembly step. Scale comes from the 10000 × 20000 mm outer dimension chains, about 36.4 px/m. The four elevations give a 4.5 m wall height.

**Spaces.** The building has:
- one open top lobby across the full width, with no wall at x ≈ 4.26 m above the corridor's north end;
- a north–south corridor that widens eastward into an open circulation area, kept as one space;
- two west offices, a large west room, two east rooms and a bottom-right room.

**Openings.**
- **Windows:** 11.
- **Exterior doors:** 3 (north, south, east). All are hosted on the outer walls.
- **Interior doors:** 7.

Four sampled same-space and separate-space relations matched the source ownership.

**Heights.**
- **Windows:** the small ones (7 on the south, west and east walls) are z 1.0–2.8. The 4800 mm windows (north, west and east) are z 1.0–3.4.
- **Exterior doors:** z 0.2–2.6, read from the 200 / 2400 / 1900 chains.
- **Coverage:** these 14 exterior heights are linked to located elevation claims, confirmed unchanged against the source. Every exterior facade shows full coverage.

**Assumptions and gaps.**
- The 7 interior doors are z 0–2.1 by assumption; no elevation shows them.
- The pixel-to-metre calibration is my own choice, not independently verified.
- Room uses are all unknown.
- Wall thickness is not modelled; the outer walls are drawn about 0.54 m thick.
- Door swing states are unknown.
- The claim boxes on the elevation images are approximate, and I did not run a per-opening positional check against the elevations.
- Only four space relations were sampled. I did not run the wall-support or opening-review checks.
- The saved notes still carry the original "room uses not assigned" text. I did not run the note-replacement revision.
